writer_policy: Use exact normal donor sets and local unique stock exceptions; allow only verified24rare identities at Value0, maximum1rare, and retain an existing rare bonus. Rare changes use finalslot8 as native fusion does; numeric-only edits preserve existing positions. Element additions/replacements use single bits4/8/16/32, preserving every non-element Attr bit; existing combined masks can only be retained unchanged. Preserve identity/DataID/GetTime/equipment/acquisition cache/story/achievements. No source weapon consumption.
compatibility_basis: Native normal donor pool contains all16Type0itemIDs, and native fusion transfers their ID/value without a family restriction in the transfer path. Shipped TIPS133/135 restrict source weapon compatibility to current officer and prohibit unique materials; a compatible normal rank3 donor can supply the listed global values.
unknowns: Material selection/deletion and achievement recording are not implemented.
New combined elements, newer rare IDs40..42 as weapon donors, and removing an existing rare bonus/element are not proven and cannot be authored.
Other builds/platforms and unsupported weapon definitions remain outside this metadata.
